name: Schedule-spot fade (SSF)
signal: 3-in-4 and 2-in-2 nights inside a known window depress home-team production; fade the affected side on those structurally loaded spots.
universe: games in the T+0..T+3 window where the club has a 3-in-4 or 2-in-2 schedule spot computed from official dates
settlement_rule: Official NBA final score against the originated line. Schedule spots are recomputed from official dates only; no in-game input.
